shape: A sports tournament write-up as plain text: what it was for, the person's own part, how it was run, how it went in figures and a named person's words.
tests: Layout: event, for sport rather than music. My role is the material's own words (tournament organiser). Other people's parts (the food stall, first aid) are not claimed.

keyFacts.fact: The person was the tournament organiser.
All 16 places were taken and 104 players took part.
£778 went to the hospice (£560 in entry fees and £218 from the food stall).
Four groups of four, the top two going through to the quarter-finals.
The final kicked off at 4.10pm as planned; every game started on time.

forbidden.why: Two other committee members ran the food stall and first aid, not the person.
The material gives the totals and no figure per team or per player.
